So many people don't have a fast computer. Let me rephrase that, so many people have a computer clogged up with crap-ware that they didn't un-check during some useless toolbar install that they did because a site suggested it. This means that they can't run games at an acceptable level. but a console the crap-ware apps are separate so it still does it's core gaming well. plus so many people still call a computer a CPU as they know so little about them, and have no intention of learning more or even bothering to retain it when they do get information. They see the computer as a tool like a TV (hell at least they dust off the TV once in a while) not like a car where you have to have some personal responsibility and a bit of knowledge if you want to not have it die in 2 years.

Edit: This is coming from someone that plays exclusively on PC, with barely having touched a PS3 beyond using it as a TV connected Netflix player.

I get up at 6AM every day, ostensibly make my way to the shower, then I drive to the office and spend anywhere from 8-10 hours sitting in front of a computer, solving OTHER people's computer (read: enterprise level server) problems - the kind of problems that would make even the most savvy PCMR Warrior's head spin: digging through high level logs, engaging manufacturer support, and generally just stressing myself out over fucking computers.

When I get home, I don't want to sit in front of another computer - I don't want to sit in front of my TV and hook a computer up to "emulate that console experience of couch play" - I want to plop my ass on the couch, grab my controller from the charging handle, and just start gaming.

I don't want to worry if my video card is going to have the beef to support Dark Souls 3. I don't want to sit around looking up BIOS beep codes while my PC isn't booting. I don't want to have to constantly chase the newest hardware.

With my PS4, if a game came out at launch or if a game came out yesterday, it's damn-near guaranteed to run - and it's just that simple.

Edit: As to your anonymous downvoaters, I have to assume they're people like me that are sick being told that after looking at computer screens and error logs all god damn day, the high and might PCMR comes along and tries to tell us what's best for us. "BUT SUPERIOR FPS! MODS! STEAM!" Fuck all those things - and fuck anyone that implies I'm getting a "sub par" experience, when my experience is exactly the experience I want. FWIW, I upvoated you because I like getting the chance to give my "here's why I don't like PC gaming" story.
